summary: Vale S.A. filed a Form 6-K responding to B3/CVM inquiries about a media report that it shelved plans for an IPO of Vale Base Metals. The company reiterated prior clarifications that no studies or decisions regarding a public offering or capital structure transaction were ongoing. It confirmed no new material facts existed requiring disclosure. This is a routine regulatory clarification, not a special-situation event; no transaction terms, board actions, or structural changes were announced.
